landing.title: CPA platform built for Central Asia
landing.subtitle: Manage advertisers and affiliates in one secure monorepo stack with real-time analytics, RBAC and localized experiences.

items.title: Role-based portals
items.description: Dedicated spaces for admin, operator, targetologist, advertiser and affiliate users.

items.title: Insights in minutes
items.description: Track clicks, leads, approvals, EPC and eCPA with hourly & daily rollups.

items.title: Production ready
items.description: Dockerized infrastructure using PostgreSQL, Redis, BullMQ queues and MinIO storage.

items.question: How do I onboard?
items.answer: Create an account, verify your email and wait for admin approval to access dashboards.

items.question: How are payouts handled?
items.answer: Monthly payout periods with workflow approvals ensure compliant affiliate payments.
